explanation: This unit only fires while the agent keeps choosing a1, and is 0 at every step during stretches where it chooses a2. In a1 stretches, D1 is 10 when the previous trial went unrewarded after a rewarded one (2-4 if it was a second unrewarded trial in a row, 0-1 after a reward, now and then 5-7 after a reward that came via a rare transition); GO is 1-3; D2 is 4-6 in a trial whose D1 was high and 1-3 otherwise.
